title: Parabolas: Vertex, Focus and Directrix
seo_title: Algebra II Parabolas: Focus and Directrix Worksheets (TEKS 2A.4B)
domain: Quadratic and Square Root Functions, Equations, and Inequalities
standard_text: 2A.4B write the equation of a parabola using given attributes, including vertex, focus, directrix, axis of symmetry, and direction of opening
meta_desc: Free Algebra II worksheets for Texas TEKS 2A.4B: vertex, focus and directrix of parabolas, writing equations, axis of symmetry and direction of opening. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: (x − h)² = 4p(y − k): focus (h, k + p), directrix y = k − p.
key_sub: The vertex is halfway between the focus and the directrix.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A parabola is the set of points the same distance from a point (the focus) and a line (the directrix).
  • The vertex is halfway between the focus and the directrix.
  • Opens up or down: (x − h)2 = 4p(y − k), focus (h, k + p), directrix y = k − p.
  • Opens left or right: (y − k)2 = 4p(x − h), focus (h + p, k), directrix x = h − p.
  • p > 0 opens up or right; p < 0 opens down or left. In y = a(x − h)2 + k, a = 14p.

Examples

Example

Focus (2, 5), directrix y = 1

Vertex (2, 3)

p = 2, 4p = 8

Answer: (x − 2)2 = 8(y − 3)

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Using p instead of 4pMultiply p by 4.
The wrong sign of pA focus below the vertex gives p < 0.
Using the focus as the vertexThe vertex is halfway between focus and directrix.

faq.q: Does the parabola pass through the focus?
faq.a: No. The focus is inside the curve.

faq.a: The line through the vertex and the focus.

items.q: Which way does the parabola (x + 3)2 = −2(y + 1) open, and what is its axis of symmetry?
items.e: The squared variable is x, so the parabola opens up or down. 4p = −2 is negative, so it opens down. The axis passes through the vertex (−3, −1). Opens down; axis of symmetry x = −3.

items.q: Which way does the parabola x2 = −4y open, and what is its axis of symmetry?
items.e: The squared variable is x, so the parabola opens up or down. 4p = −4 is negative, so it opens down. The axis passes through the vertex (0, 0). Opens down; axis of symmetry x = 0.
